title: A Mayfly Swarm Was So Big the Weather Radar Saw a Storm

scenes.text: Weather radar once mistook bugs for a storm.
In July 2014, mayflies erupted off the Mississippi River.
The National Weather Service in La Crosse, Wisconsin, saw them on radar.
The swarm looked as strong as a moderate thunderstorm.
Millions of mayflies coated the roads near the river.
It wasn't rain. It was a storm made of bugs.

description:
In July 2014, a mayfly swarm over the Mississippi River was so big it showed up on weather radar.
Meteorologists said it looked as strong as a moderate thunderstorm, and roads near the river were coated in the insects.
Would you drive through that?
thumbnail_text: BUGS SHOWED UP AS A STORM
first_comment: Have you ever seen a swarm this big?
